summary: Iteration 2 test pass. 14/14 backend pytest cases passed (FAQ, Careers, Cancellation Policy, Professionals register+approval, Testimonials, Renewal status, Notify subscribe MOCKED, Admin roles/orders, Booking cancel with 100% refund, Booking reschedule, Chat Claude Sonnet 4.5 send+history + auth guard). Frontend flows verified: topbar Register-as-Professional link, /reviews, /faq (Booking/Cancellation categories rendered), /careers, /about, /register-professional (validation + submit -> Application received screen), Download-App modal with notify-me email (MOCKED subscribe), Chat widget: shows sign-in prompt when logged out, sends & receives reply from Claude when admin is logged in. Admin login redirects to /admin, dropdown menu (menu-account/menu-admin/menu-logout) works, admin 6 tabs render, approve/reject buttons present after seeded pro application, role dropdowns present, policy tab shows 100%. Customer booking cancel flow via UI works end-to-end: dialog shows policy, confirm triggers 100% refund toast, booking marked CANCELLED with refund breakdown persisted.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: on direct navigation to /account, useEffect checks !user without waiting for AuthContext loading state, causing brief redirect to /login before token restores. Works if navigating via header dropdown. Admin.js already handles this correctly with `if (loading) return`.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warnings in console (not blocking)

action_items: Optional: Add `if (loading) return;` guard to Account.js useEffect (mirror Admin.js) to avoid brief /login redirect on hard-refresh of /account.
Optional: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Dialog components to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat replays prior history by calling llm.send_message for each prior user message in a loop — this doubles token cost and adds latency on every send. Better: pass history via LlmChat's built-in memory (session_id is already set) or store transcripts and construct a single context prompt.
server.py is 940 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, services, cart, bookings, admin, chat, static-content) as it grows.
compute_refund_pct assumes UTC slot; user's timezone not considered — could produce unexpected refund tiers for near-boundary slots.
reschedule doesn't validate the new slot is in the future.
Frontend Account.js directly redirects to /login without waiting for auth loading — race condition mentioned above.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new iteration-2 endpoints & flows verified end-to-end. Race condition in Account.js is minor and doesn't block flows via header dropdown navigation. Chat uses Claude Sonnet 4.5 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY successfully.
rca of the issue: Account.js race: useEffect only depends on [user, navigate]; on hard-refresh AuthProvider first renders with user=null while token is being validated (or before /auth/me returns). Fix: import `loading` from useAuth and add `if (loading) return;` guard, mirroring Admin.js pattern.
